Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vihaan - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anita - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Ananya - 9 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
4. Vimla - 71 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Kavya - 9 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anita, Vimla and Kavya stand near him.]

Vimla: "What lovely weather!"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Vihaan: "That's great!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Anita: "Let's see."

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Vihaan: "What next?"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Vihaan stands by the road. Anita, Ananya and Vimla stand near him.]

Anita: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan gets into the car.]

Ananya: "Yes, of course."

[Vihaan gets on the bus.]

Vihaan: "That's great!"

[Vihaan gets off the school bus.]

Vimla (surprised): "Exactly right."

[Vihaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ananya: "Aunty, look at this."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Anita and Kavya stand near him.]

Anita: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Vihaan: "That was fun!"

[Vihaan puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Vihaan: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Night

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anita, Ananya and Vimla stand near him.]

Vimla: "What a nice place."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Vihaan: "How beautiful!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Anita: "That was such a fun day!"
